name: iCloud Saves
author: OpenDejenol
description: macOS only: keeps copies of your saved world in iCloud Drive, to carry on playing on another Mac

settings.label: Upload at save points
settings.description: Copies the saves to iCloud Drive on returning to town and when the game ends.

settings.label: Check iCloud at start
settings.description: Offers a newer world from iCloud Drive at the main menu, before anything is loaded.
